reviews.text: This restaurant is conveniently located in the heart of the bustling city center and is easily accessible by subway. The interior is simple yet stylishly decorated, clean and bright, and the space between seats is wide so it doesn't feel crowded. Speaking of food, the signature dish, pork belly jjim, has a rich, juicy texture, but is not greasy; it melts in your mouth and is plentiful. The steamed sea bass is fresh, soft, light, and perfectly seasoned. The waiters are friendly and attentive, respond quickly and the food comes out quickly. The price is also reasonable, making it excellent value for money. However, we recommend making a reservation as you may have to wait for about 30 minutes during peak weekend evening hours. Overall, it was a very satisfying dining experience, perfect for a gathering of friends or family, and I would recommend it to anyone. I will definitely come back to try other menu items.

reviews.text: I went to dinner with my family on a weekend evening, and reserved a window seat in advance. I ordered the signature dishes: steamed pork ribs, steamed sea bass, garlic scallop vermicelli, and vegetable salad. Although the braised pork ribs were moderately greasy, they were not greasy and melted in the mouth, and with just the right amount of sweetness, they lived up to their name as a representative dish. The steamed sea bass was tender, perfectly cooked, and lightly and healthy seasoned. The scallops were also very fresh and had a rich garlic flavor. The staff provided friendly and attentive service, serving food at a reasonable speed and taking care of filling water and plates first. The restaurant was clean and tidy, with a simple yet elegant interior. However, it was a bit noisy during peak hours so you had to raise your voice to have a conversation. The price was a bit expensive, but the portion was generous. Three people came out with 380 yuan. Overall, it was a satisfactory experience, and I would like to visit again next time or recommend it to my friends.

reviews.text: When I bought a new bed, the response was excellent, but when I came back to look at the baby bed, it was so bad. Should I go there without making a reservation? An employee was assigned to provide guidance, but the explanation was not systematic at all, and even parts that needed a thorough explanation were only answered when you asked questions. In addition, it is common sense that mattresses for very young babies should have high hardness, but I couldn't find any professionalism in recommending a regular hardness mattress. Too bad!

reviews.author: He's a villain
reviews.text: It is extremely expensive, the service is messed up, and the customer is responsible for incorrect contract terms. They are asking for a ridiculous penalty.. This is a contract where the employee paid a lump sum by signing the contract explained and written by the employee and handing over my card. I don't know if it is right to ask for an additional fee or cancellation of the payment because the contract discount rate was incorrectly measured. The customer's penalty for non-compliance with the contract is specified in the contract, but why is the contract breach compensation for normal payment of the normal amount informed to the customer? I have to suffer damage for nothing.

reviews.author: Bri
reviews.text:
I had a really great experience at Ahla Collective last week. The space was beautiful and I liked the clean, minimalist atmosphere. I learned about their value, “A Hand Looking For A Hand,” which is to create a space where artists can communicate with a wider audience and where art lovers can encounter a variety of contemporary art works.

I also liked the fact that it was located in Sinsa-dong, so it was good for taking a walk around the area after viewing the gallery.

We plan new exhibitions every two or three months, so check out our ongoing exhibitions on Instagram @afhlah.collective. Highly recommended!

reviews.text: This gallery is located not far from the southern end of Dongho Bridge and opened in 2008. I visited for the first time after seeing an article that a solo exhibition by German painter Axel Krause would be held from July 4th to August 1st. Although the exhibition hall was not large, it was located in the basement, so it was quiet and a good space for concentration. In particular, the atmosphere matched well with the works on display, so it was great to enjoy them.
